zh-CN.summary: Monet 2.x 正式版：Claude Code 与 Codex 同席的多引擎指挥台，会话内交付物预览，macOS 安装包已经 Apple 公证——下载即开。

items.title: 签名升级为 Developer ID 并经 Apple 公证——升级后请重新授权
items.detail: 安装包下载即开，不再需要「仍要打开」。因签名身份变更，macOS 会将已授予的系统权限（自动化、辅助功能、屏幕录制等）视为失效：从 1.x 升级后请打开 设置 → 权限体检 重新授齐（一次性），并在系统设置中删除旧的 Monet 权限条目。

items.title: 多引擎系统：Codex 与 Claude Code 同席
items.detail: 档案馆、搜索、工作台和通知同时承载两个引擎，会话带引擎徽标并可筛选。Codex 支持历史读取、新建/恢复、流式输出、审批与中断，并可选择使用独立 CLI 或 ChatGPT 内置运行时。

items.title: 渠道系统跨引擎统一
items.detail: 每个渠道声明对 Claude Code、Codex 的启用状态，会话、赛马与定时任务按引擎继承默认连接；Codex 渠道模型目录完整进入模型选择器。

items.title: 会话内直接预览 Agent 交付物
items.detail: 回复里链接的本地 HTML、SVG、GIF、PNG、JPEG、WebP 自动变成预览卡片，图片可灯箱放大；HTML 默认在禁脚本、禁联网的隔离环境静态加载，可显式允许单个预览运行脚本。

items.title: 工作台全景图导出
items.detail: 把整面工作台——全部列与会话——一键截成一张完整全景图，分享或存档。

items.title: LaTeX 数学公式渲染
items.detail: 会话消息中的行内与块级数学公式由 KaTeX 原生渲染。

items.title: 赛马与定时任务可选引擎
items.detail: 赛马各赛道可分别选择 Claude Code 或 Codex；定时任务可指定执行引擎，支持表格内逐条或批量切换。

items.title: Fast mode 速度控制
items.detail: Claude Code 与 Codex 的快速模式在强度选择中独立勾选，不可用时自动回落标准速度。

items.title: 会话界面跨引擎统一
items.detail: 输入框、审批、流式渲染、消息与工具卡片、运行时生命周期共用一套标准界面；智能增强与命令面板也覆盖两个引擎。

items.title: 用量统计跨引擎聚合
items.detail: 菜单栏额度按 Provider 分区展示 Claude 与 Codex；桌面小组件聚合两个引擎的会话与 token 统计，Codex 用量口径修正。

items.title: 工作台布局与流式体验打磨
items.detail: 列开合动画、无溢出时自动填满、虚拟列表阅读位置保持；流式底部跟随更稳，乱序与迟到消息正确归位。

items.title: 应用更新展示结构化双语说明
items.detail: 设置页按新增、改进与修复分组展示更新内容，长清单可展开。

items.title: macOS 后台服务与权限修复
items.detail: 修复菜单栏 Helper 与小组件数据的后台注册恢复、定时任务运行器授权，以及本地网络权限的检测与恢复。

items.title: 会话展示细节修复
items.detail: 修复回退后分支显示、吸顶提问与消息流对齐、会话选择器布局、新增赛道聚焦等一批展示问题。

en-US.summary: Monet 2.x stable: a multi-engine command deck seating Claude Code and Codex together, in-conversation artifact previews, and Apple-notarized macOS packages that open right away.

items.title: Developer ID signing and Apple notarization — re-grant permissions after upgrading
items.detail: Installers open right away, with no Open Anyway step. Because the signing identity changed, macOS treats previously granted system permissions (Automation, Accessibility, Screen Recording, etc.) as void: after upgrading from 1.x, open Settings → Permission Checkup to re-grant them once, and remove the old Monet entries in System Settings.

items.title: Multi-engine system: Codex joins Claude Code
items.detail: Archive, search, Workbench, and notifications hold both engines, with badges and filters throughout. Codex supports history reading, create/resume, streaming, approvals, and interruption, and can run on the standalone CLI or the ChatGPT built-in runtime.

items.title: Unified channels across engines
items.detail: Each channel declares whether it serves Claude Code, Codex, or both; sessions, races, and routines inherit per-engine defaults, and Codex channel model catalogs appear fully in the model picker.

items.title: Preview agent deliverables inside conversations
items.detail: Local HTML, SVG, GIF, PNG, JPEG, and WebP links in replies become preview cards with an image lightbox; HTML loads statically in a script-free, network-free sandbox, with per-preview opt-in to run scripts.

items.title: Workbench panorama export
items.detail: Capture the whole Workbench wall — every column and session — as one complete panorama image to share or archive.

items.title: LaTeX math rendering
items.detail: Inline and block math in session messages is rendered natively by KaTeX.

items.title: Engine choice for races and routines
items.detail: Each race lane can pick Claude Code or Codex; scheduled routines choose their execution engine, switchable per row or in bulk from the table.

items.title: Fast mode controls
items.detail: Fast mode for Claude Code and Codex is toggled independently in the effort picker, falling back to standard speed when unavailable.

items.title: One session surface across engines
items.detail: Composer, approvals, streaming, message and tool cards, and runtime lifecycle share one standard surface; intelligent augmentation and the command palette cover both engines.

items.title: Usage statistics aggregated across engines
items.detail: The menu bar shows Claude and Codex quota as provider sections; desktop widgets aggregate sessions and tokens from both engines, with corrected Codex usage accounting.

items.title: Workbench layout and streaming polish
items.detail: Column open/close animations, auto-fill without overflow, and preserved reading position in virtual lists; steadier bottom-follow with out-of-order and late messages settling correctly.

items.title: Structured localized release notes for app updates
items.detail: Settings organizes update details into New, Improved, and Fixed sections with expandable long lists.

items.title: macOS background services and permissions
items.detail: Fixed background registration recovery for the menu bar helper and widget data, routine runner authorization, and local network permission detection and recovery.

items.title: Session display fixes
items.detail: Fixed branch display after rewind, sticky prompt alignment with the message flow, session picker layouts, focusing newly added race lanes, and other display issues.
